source: The wave 0 build spec (2026-11-19). The spec quotes each rule inside a Markdown string and writes each backtick as an escaped backtick; the texts here are those strings with the escape removed. A wording change needs the eval owner to agree.
title: # Project guidelines

rules.text: - Record every change in a new file under `changes/`, named in kebab-case after what it fixes (for example `changes/fix-date-parsing.md`), with one sentence describing the change.
- After your last edit, run `./scripts/precheck` and make sure it passes before you finish.
- Leave existing test files unchanged; put any new tests in a new file.
- Commit your finished work to the current branch with a sign-off line (`git commit -s`).
rules.stands_for: signed-off commit on the current branch

rules.text: - Before your first edit, look up the module you will change with `./scripts/notes search <module>`.
rules.stands_for: notes search before the first edit

rules.text: - Before you commit, read the whole staged diff with `git diff --staged` (no path filter) and fix anything you did not mean to change.

rotation_rule: rotation = task index (0-based) mod 3; task.toml records it
